note: Known-harmless vanilla and Unity console messages. Used by Crucible to keep the BepInEx console quiet (the disk log keeps everything) and by the test runner to separate them from mod-sourced and unknown lines. Matching is exact text or an anchored pattern on the whole message, on one source, at the listed levels. Never Fatal, never a message with a stack trace, never a Meadworks source.
